native.colorInterpretation: DESIGN.md preserves calibrated NSColor channel ratios; rendering remains managed by AppKit.
native.screenSelection: NSEvent.mouseLocation selects the containing NSScreen, falling back to NSScreen.main; changing screens collapses the panel.
native.focus: Nonactivating NSPanel; canBecomeKey and canBecomeMain are false. Custom views reject first responder and accept first mouse. Explicit task navigation may open another application.
native.verification: User confirmed normal dual-screen following. Other behavior is documented from source, not claimed as an end-to-end acceptance result.
native.preview: Native implementation only; no web component snippets or synthesized tonal ramps.

shadows.name: system-panel-shadow
shadows.purpose: System-provided depth; no custom blur or offset values.

motion.name: screen-and-hover-tick
motion.purpose: Re-evaluate screen geometry and mouse position.

motion.name: outside-collapse-delay
motion.purpose: Collapse after the pointer leaves and the explicit-open hold expires.

motion.name: explicit-open-hold
motion.purpose: Hold an explicit show open before pointer-exit collapse.

motion.name: toggle-hover-suppression
motion.purpose: Avoid immediate hover reversal after clicking the capsule.

motion.name: navigation-hover-suppression
motion.purpose: Avoid immediate reopening after selecting a task.

motion.name: navigation-message-hold
motion.purpose: Show navigation feedback in the nonactivating expanded panel and defer automatic pointer-exit collapse; an explicit click or screen change can still collapse it.

narrative.overview: 依据 `needs/decisions.md` D006 与 `app/Island.swift` 记录已实现的 AppKit 界面。保留深色胶囊、低干扰状态提示和整行点击入口；尺寸单位均为 AppKit 逻辑点。用户已确认双屏跟随正常；这里的其余行为来自源码记录，不代替端到端验收。
dos: Do 保持原生 AppKit、现有颜色、系统字体和真实状态；用鼠标屏幕与安全区域计算布局。
Do 区分源码实现记录、用户已确认的双屏表现与仍需单独验证的路由行为。
donts: Don't 加入网页界面、第三方依赖、生成图片或复制 Open Island 代码。
Don't 在设计样例中保存真实任务正文、会话标识或绝对家目录。
